title: The MCP Bridge: AL Language Tools for Every Agent
summary: The MCP Bridge is a VS Code extension that exposes AL Language tools as an MCP server, enabling any MCP-aware agent (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) to access compilation diagnostics and test feedback. This closes the feedback loop for agentic AL development, moving beyond GitHub Copilot as the only agent with AL language tool access.
key_points: Agents need three components: the model, tools, and fast feedback loops to work effectively on code
AL language diagnostics and tests are critical feedback mechanisms for agents, preventing confident hallucinations
The MCP Bridge extension makes AL Language tools available to any MCP-compatible agent, not just GitHub Copilot
Installation requires no new ceremony - agents access the tools once pointed at the MCP server
features: AL Language tools exposure via MCP

quotes.text: diagnostics and tests are not nice-to-haves. They are the feedback loop
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes why AL language tools matter: they provide essential feedback preventing agents from writing broken code
